column2: 為顧及數據的精確度及保障個別受訪者的私隱，人數少的單元區會與鄰近的單元區合併為「單元區–小合併組」或「單元區–大合併組」後才發布統計數字。「單元區–小合併組」及「單元區–大合併組」的人口分別為最少400人及最少1 000人。
** - 由於抽樣誤差大，有關統計數字不予公布。
(1) - 數字包括報稱有多於一個種族的人士。
(2) - 數字不包括失去語言能力的人士。
(3) - 2021 年人口普查採用了新的職業分類方法，此職業分類方法更為貼近「國際標準職業分類法2008 年版」。
(4) - 數字是按「香港標準行業分類2.0 版」為藍本的行業分類而編製。
(5) - 「其他」包括「農業、林業及漁業」、「採礦及採石」、「電力及燃氣供應」、「自來水供應；污水處理、廢棄物管理及污染防治活動」等行業，及報稱的行業不能辨別或描述不足。
(6) - 數字包括（一）由一對已婚夫婦而並無其他親屬所組成的住戶；（二）由一對夫婦及其未婚子女而並無其他親屬所組成的住戶；及（三）由父／母一方及其未婚子女而並無其他親屬所組成的住戶。這類住戶可包括或不包括其他無親屬關係的同住人士，例如家庭傭工。
(7) - 數字包括（一）由一對夫婦及其至少一個父或母親（包括夫婦雙方的父母親）而並無其他親屬所組成的住戶；（二）由一對夫婦、至少一個父或母親（包括夫婦雙方的父母親）及其未婚子女而並無其他親屬所組成的住戶；及（三）由一羣有親屬關係人士所組成但未能歸入其他類別的住戶。這類住戶可包括或不包括其他無親屬關係的同住人士，例如家庭傭工。
(8) - 數字包括只有一個人的住戶及由一羣無親屬關係人士所組成的住戶。
(9) - 租金金額是 0 的住戶包括居住在親友家中無論是否得到許可而沒有繳付租金的住戶、向三房客收取的租金總值超過或相等於大租的二房東住戶及由僱主免費提供住所的住戶。

Having regard to data precision and protection of data privacy of individual respondents, a Subunit with a small population is merged with adjacent Subunit(s) as a Small Subunit Group or Large Subunit Group for the release of statistics.  There are at least 400 persons and at least 1 000 persons in a Small Subunit Group and a Large Subunit Group respectively.

(1) - Figures include persons who reported more than one ethnicity.
(3) - A new occupation classification scheme which follows “International Standard Classification Occupations 2008 (ISCO-08)” more closely was adopted in the 2021 Population Census.
(4) - Figures are compiled based on the industry classification modelled on the Hong Kong Standard Industrial Classification Version 2.0.

(5) - "Others" include "Agriculture, forestry and fishing"; "Mining and quarrying"; "Electricity and gas supply"; "Water supply; sewerage, waste management and remediation activities" and industrial activities unidentifiable or inadequately described.

(6) - Figures include (i) households comprising a married couple without any other related persons; (ii) households comprising a couple and their unmarried child(ren) without any other related persons; and (iii) households comprising a father or mother and his/ her unmarried child(ren) without any other related persons. These households may or may not include other unrelated persons (e.g. domestic helpers).

(7) - Figures include (i) households comprising a couple and at least one of their parents (including the parent(s) of the wife and/ or husband) without any other related persons; (ii) households comprising a couple, at least one of their parents (including the parent(s) of the wife and/ or husband) and their unmarried children without any other related persons; and (iii) households comprising a group of related persons but not being classified in the other categories. These households may or may not include other unrelated persons (e.g. domestic helpers).
(8) - Figures include households with only one person and households comprising unrelated person(s).

(9) - Zero rent households include households living in accommodation of friends or relatives without paying any rent with or without permission, main tenant households with total rental receipts from sub-tenant(s) greater than or equal to rent paid, and those households whose quarters were provided free by employers.
